The business serves DIY mechanics, independent repair shops, and vehicle owners seeking affordable replacement parts.
Its inventory spans all makes and models, supporting the automotive repair and auto-recycling sectors in the region.
The self-service model was introduced to give customers direct access to low-cost used parts without the markup of traditional counter sales.
By eliminating labor charges for part removal, the yard positions itself as a cost-driven alternative for budget-conscious repair work.
